shots.purpose: Throw the audience into Fuzzby’s self-made weather before anyone has time to arrange themselves around it.
shots.performanceAssignment: Fuzzby treats velocity as competence; the routine pollen dip becomes too committed, too low, then suddenly leaf-owned.
shots.camera: The camera follows and struggles, losing clean containment for a breath as the leaf bends under him and springs him off-course.
shots.openingPose: Fuzzby is already pitched diagonally into travel, chanting, with Zenny calm in the corridor as the still measure he refuses to notice.
shots.cutInMotivation: The launch-to-ricochet must be felt as one overcommitted cause; cutting inside it would turn momentum into obstacle coverage and weaken the body-written joke.
shots.dialogueBinding: FUZZBY's vocal beat performs per the approved voice design.

dialogueLines.delivery: [excited] Start already in motion, crisp and proud: “BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY, BIZZY-BIZZY-BIZZY…” Let the last beat wobble as the leaf recoil steals his trajectory.

shots.visualPayoff: The leaf snaps back trembling, pollen hanging where Fuzzby used to be, his path kicked out of neatness.
prohibited: Open with Fuzzby already in motion and mid-chant; no neutral hover start.
Leaf compression, recoil and trembling pollen after-beat must prove his weight and the environmental cause.
Maintain Zenny as the still measure within readable flower-corridor geography.

shots.referenceRolesProse: Fuzzby identity/performance reference anchors his body scale, hover behaviour and overconfident wing-driven rhythm; Zenny identity/performance reference anchors her composed stillness; flower corridor, leaf and pollen references anchor bee-height scale, contact weight and warm meadow continuity.
shots.physicalPerformanceApproved: Fuzzby enters already committed, chant driving his wing rhythm and chest-forward importance. His pollen dip is too confident to adjust: he lowers past the safe line, the leaf catches his weight, folds under him, then springs back hard enough to kick his path sideways. He tries to keep the chant alive through the recoil, but his body has already been re-authored by the leaf.
shots.animationTimingApproved: No neutral start: motion is mid-sentence on frame one. Let the chant sit in a brisk, even pulse, then shorten the spacing as the dip becomes overcommitted. Hold the leaf compression just long enough to prove weight, then snap the recoil faster than Fuzzby can prepare for; leave a tiny trembling after-beat on the leaf and pollen cloud after he is gone.

voiceDirectorBrief.expectedTiming: Audio is already underway at frame one, as though the chant began before the cut. Keep the first half in brisk pulse, compress the timing during the over-low dip, and let the final ellipsis carry into the snap-away and trembling pollen after-beat.
voiceDirectorBrief.physicalActionRelationship: Voice supports the body’s lie at first — velocity equals competence — then is jostled by the leaf so the chant becomes evidence of denial.
